n. 礼物, 赠予, 天才

gift card laundering.definition:
The act of using a gift card to purchase another gift card of equal or slightly greater value in order to hide the fact that you're just regifting the original gift card.
> After I do some gift card laundering at the mall today, these gift cards I got last Christmas will be squeaky clean and ready for regifting. No one will ever catch on to my operation - muhahaHAHA!

gift coupons.translation: [经] (商品中所附可换赠品的)赠券

gift crack.definition:
The gap in wrapping paper or uncovered portion of a gift usually found on the bottom of the box.  May result from the gift wrapper running out of paper or cutting gift wrap too small to cover the entire package.
> Bryan figured out what his present was because the gift crack exposed the picture on the box.

gift inter vivos.translation: [经] 在生前赠与的礼品(物品), 遗赠品

gift parasite.definition:
A person who adds their name to a gift tag in order to claim partial credit for giving the gift.
> I'm totally broke so I had to be a gift parasite and sign on that present you're giving Grandma.
